rationale: The only implementation delta is the per-plane copy extent: the fixed version derives plane dimensions with PlaneSize and passes its byte width to CopyPlane, whereas the vulnerable version passes Columns and Rows, with Columns being unsuitable for byte-based widths for some formats. The Logic section states only that content from each plane is copied; this behavioral description holds for both versions and does not specify the copy dimensions, byte-versus-pixel interpretation, or any added guard/check.
